lines.text: UNIT 8
NUTRITION
In previous unit,we studied that all organisms need energy to perform their
functions. We also know that they get this energy by the oxidation of food.
Heterotrophs obtainfood from others.On theother hand,autotrophs make their
own food by photosynthesis.For making their food,autotrophs need to take
essentialmaterialsfromtheirenvironment.
Nutrients arethematerials(elements and compounds)that organisms obtainand
use for maintaining life. The term "nutrition"means the processes in which
organisms obtain essential materials for makingfoodortakefoodmadebyothers,
and convert it into substances for growth, energy and regulating various body
functions, In this unit,we will study what the nutritional requirements of plants
are?We will also study the components of human food and theprocess by which
foodisdigestedinhumanbody.

Pointto remember
Without food, our bodies can not stay warm, build or repair tissue or
maintain a heartbeat. Eating the right foods can help us avoid certain
